note: RS30 Ultra Max (G0155): its own stock settings tree (newsettings v1.1.42 settings_tree_product_athena35ultramax) and game menu (xhplayer Product_athena35ultramax = BaseConfigKt.getDianaConfigList, the X50 list with the first colour space item), mapped in devices/g0155/research/RS30_MENU_STOCK.md. The X50 apps send the same HAL codes here (devices/g0111/hal/codes.tsv is proven against devices/g0155/research/aidl_codes.tsv), so every row below is an X50 row whose stock node the RS30 tree has too. Picture modes: its SDR list in its order with its own vendor ids (X50Projector ModelMenu.RS30: AI 10, Sport 9, Movie 1, Colour accuracy 29, Bright 40, Performance 5 behind the stock overheating warning; this model has no Boost, so nothing else is sent). Screen mirroring (Miracast, apps/LumenMiracast, in the image since t3) is a tile as on the Z9X and the Play 6, built only where the receiver found Wi-Fi Direct on this unit (the stock vendor runs wpa_supplicant with p2p_supplicant.conf and its own Wi-Fi display HAL; the receiver decides at run time). Eye protection is a plain on/off switch on this stock (more_eye, setHumanDetectOnOff, no follow / rest choice, no hint picture). Light rows as this model's stock has them (X50Projector StockLight, evidence in devices/g0111/research/LIGHT_ROWS_STOCK.md): light source level 1..10 (DisplayManager 6/7, no Boost on this model: feature support_brightness_boost 0, stock never reads 152 here). Iris (stock node picture_iris_ring_adjustment_athena3ultramax, first row of the stock image page under the light level): f/2.0, f/3.0, f/4.0, f/5.5, f/7.0, dynamic in the stock order on GmTvManager 199/200 (values 0 dynamic, 20, 30, 40, 55, 70, vendor default 0 dynamic). While it reads dynamic, f/5.5 or f/7.0 the light level is refused with the stock note (IrisRule, stock DisplayMutexManager.setDlpLumenLevel, the vendor pq interceptor refuses it too), the iris is refused in the office and performance picture modes (stock SettingMutexManager) and, as its vendor pq database refuses it, any iris but f/2.0 in Bright. Dynamic black (172/174), never in the PC, office or HDR Vivid picture mode. The family rows the X50 tree has too (ModelMenu Family): motion compensation off / weak / medium / strong and the original frame (160 (0, 1) behind the stock mutex: not with Ultra 120 Hz, not in 3D), colour gamut native / BT.2020 / Adobe RGB / DCI-P3 / BT.709 (Adobe RGB on this tree only), AI contrast, super resolution, rainbow reduction. Its own stock row beyond the X50 tree (ModelMenu.RS30 extras): screen displacement (move_only) with the pan-tilt head past the picture's edge. Game menu: the X50 items; VRR goes on only at top speed (support_vrr_only_at_top_speed true). 3D: the five modes of its stock tree (image_3d_info_state without frame packing), the X50 calls and refusal list (X50Projector X50ThreeD); as its stock does, Off skips the game mode and HDMI 120 Hz refusals. The family picture rows of the stock picture page (X50Projector ProPictureHal, stock calls in devices/g0111/research/allowed_x50projector.tsv): colour temperature standard / movie / D65 / balanced (DisplayManager 4/5 as stock choiceLedMode, refused in the office mode), colour optimisation, gamma (the content's own curve or manual) with its manual value 1.8..2.6, HDR dynamic tone mapping (HDR10 only, never in IMAX), local contrast, noise reduction, reset this picture mode and reset all after the stock question, colour optimisation and local contrast hidden while HDR plays (stock PictureFactory). The senior colour row of the stock General page (GmTvManager 179..182, refused in the office, performance and colour accuracy modes). rs30-parity-projection: the picture rotation page (stock RotateWind: 147 open, 142 read, 134 by 0.5 degree, the reset by the session angle, 185(true / false, 0) around the first key), the corner page inside the stock KeyStoneWind session (147, the move auto keystone paused, 185 type 0), the remote focus picture row (stock remote_focus_img_guide, our own drawing), and Auto keystone, corners, zoom, shift and rotation refused at top game speed with the stock toast (common.json gameModeFast). No lens memory row: the RS30 tree has no lens_memory node (its AgileWall walls use the same calls; not ported). Aspect ratio auto / 4:3 / 16:9 / original size on the HDMI part of the picture page (stock image_ratio_info of the signal page: newsettings PictureRepository.setImageRatio -> GmDisplayManager.setVideoRatioCommon -> XgimiService MtkVideo.setZoomMode -> GmTvManager 35 setAspectRatio, read 36; GMPF2 values auto 2, 4:3 0, 16:9 1, original 4), on an HDMI input only (support_aspectratio_overall absent), refused in the game picture mode and while the game mode is on (checkImageRatioMutex). The stock picture settings page rule (SettingMutexManager image_mode_setting, the same in the X50, RS30 and Titan newsettings): its rows refuse every write while the game mode is on (148 state 0) and in the AI or performance picture mode unless Dolby Vision plays (lumen-menu PictureSettingsRule). The colour and screen pages of the stock picture page (X50Projector ColorHal, rs30-parity-picture2): white balance with its 2-point page (red, green and blue gain and offset, GmTvManager 17..28) and 11-point page (grey level 5 .. 100 %, red, green, blue; 165 / 166), colour correction (colour, hue, saturation, lightness; 117 / 118), each with the stock Reset to defaults (164 with the page's class), the HDR enhancement page (tone mapping, screen size and gain, 185 / 186) shown while HDR plays and it is not Dolby Vision, the Dolby Vision screen page (size and gain, 73 / 76 / 77) usable only while Dolby Vision plays, the auto mode switch (162 / 163), and the style filter row only while a filter set on stock is in use, offering the way back to the model's original cube (154); the stock filter catalogue is XGIMI's online service and is not in Lumen. No custom picture mode rows: no tree of this family creates one.
